# #1722: Patch: the AI's evaluation prices banked modifiers and scheduled effects
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The practice AI judges a position by what is on the board and in hand — but it gives no credit to promises already in the bank: a "your next spell is free" waiting to be spent, a "start of turn" engine already ticking, a scheduled exile still on its way, or the opponent's alternate-win-condition meter nearing its mark. An opponent one step from a special win reads as healthy; the AI's own ticking annuity reads as nothing. After the change, those banked and scheduled effects count in the judgment, for both seats.

## Why

`evaluate()`/`material()` never read `PlayerState.mods` — zero `mods`/`ModifierKind` references in `crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs` or `features.rs` — while all 18 kinds (`CostDiscount`, `EchoNextSpell`, `RadiantFirstCheapCard`, `ComboDraw`, `StartOfTurnEffect`, `TurnEnds`, `HealToDamage`, `HeroArmor`, `AltWin`, `LaneWatch`, `HeroImmune`, `SpellDamage`, `HealthPrice`, `ReplacePlays`, …, `state.rs:440-566`) are public on both seats' views (R169, `view_for.rs:34-36`), so pricing them is R185-legal. Unmarked `state.delayed` entries likewise bank nothing: `marked_enemy_worth` deliberately skips them (`evaluate.rs:279-312`). The shadow-ban ledger records measured misfires from exactly this blind spot: gen-6 notes "/fullsend's delayed hand-exile the eval reads only once it fires" (`shadow_ban.rs:133-141`); gen-7: "the Radiant flags themselves are the part no weight prices" (:143-152); gen-4's crafted 0-cost unit read as filler (:113-120). Same pattern as the merged evaluator-terms change (#1628), different state fields.

## Proposal

Add a player-modifier term signed by kind — `AltWin` progress as closing distance, `StartOfTurnEffect` as annuity value, `TurnEnds`/`HealToDamage`/`CostRule`/`HealthPrice` adjusting the plans they warp — plus a per-entry `delayed` term signed payoff-vs-cost by hook kind (the `DELAYED_DESTROY_HOOK` read at `evaluate.rs:303` shows the classification pattern). Weights are named constants in `config.rs` (rule 9). `AI_EVAL_KIND` is `Learned` — check whether the term belongs in the hand-written eval, the dense features in `features.rs`, or both.

## Where it lands

`crates/ai/src/evaluate.rs`, `crates/ai/src/config.rs`, `crates/ai/src/features.rs` (if the learned layer should see them), tests under `crates/ai/tests/ai/`.

## Acceptance criteria

- A state holding a banked `StartOfTurnEffect` outscores an otherwise-identical state without it.
- An enemy `AltWin` near threshold reads as danger, not health.
- Scenario tests pin each new term's sign; `cargo jackioh gate` smoke gates do not regress.

## Size and risks

Medium (2–4 files). Only public information is read. Weight tuning may need a sweep — mitigate by starting with the kinds whose payoffs are already enumerated (AltWin progress, StartOfTurnEffect, delayed hooks) and leaving rare kinds at zero.
